## What changed and why

## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm run preflight` passes (or the part of it that applies, and why)
- [ ] A bug fix has a regression test that fails without the fix
- [ ] A UI change has a matching CLI change (or an entry in `tests/fixtures/parity/capabilities.json`)
- [ ] Test data does not look like a real credential
- [ ] No secrets, vault files or personal data in the diff
- [ ] I wrote this change or have the right to submit it, and I grant the maintainer a licence to use it in the project (see CONTRIBUTING.md) ([Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/))
